day.reading: neutral theory is where neo-Darwinists flee; removing selection removes Darwin
day.why_none: the slide's claim is about motive (a 1968 response to Haldane); the held text does not quote Kimura's motive

notes: The neutral fixation probability (1962), the neutral-majority argument (1968) and the 4Ne fixation time (1969) predate Day's earliest dated source (2019) by 50-57 years. Whether Kimura proposed neutrality in response to Haldane's cost (the slide) is a motive claim the held text does not settle; it does not bear on the dates.
